message:
feat(apk): kept model A -- a PC the phone keeps is a standby lease; PC 목록 ends the session (keepalive-r2 2 e, M1)

Codex codex_keepalive_r2_kept_model.md (A) and codex_ka_e_switch_decision.md (a).

- "PC 목록": the screen's fences, then the session ENDS (Disconnect, then the lease's SessionOver on the closer thread).
  From an activation: back to that same lease. An ordinary directory session of a supported directory: the FIRST
  transition -- a new lease (observe from its socket, /api/connect standby, aim at the relay when reserved), its new
  directory requests logged as such. Raw IP / an older host / a pre-login worker / no standby: "상시 유지 미지원" and the
  session closed. The old parked control session and its reuse (resumeKept, park_reuse) are gone -- M1 closes with the
  path: every activation is a new session whose UA-2 state starts empty, nothing re-sent.
- A tap on a ready lease: a NEW entry connected by that lease's activation (nativeConnectStandby: standby_adopt through
  the entry's gate) -- no directory, observe, punch or ordinary Hello. A lease still handing its socket back holds the
  tap; one not ready is let go and the tap is the ordinary connect. A lease that cannot be used goes, once.
- The leases: StandbyKeep (pure: list state, tap, list return, evictions, a Book with incarnations so a late capability
  never reaches a released / recreated lease, staging <= 1 with its own back-off). Native calls that may wait run on
  their own thread in order. An Unsupported lease (an older host) is released and not tried again this sign-in. A lease
  whose PC left the recent three goes. Leaving the app, sign-out, a refused session, 모두 끊기 and the network changing
  release them all; a card's 끊기 releases one and suppresses it.
- Preconnect.AUTO_PREPARE (was SEND_TO_REAL_HOSTS) = BuildConfig.STANDBY_AUTO_PREPARE: the app's OWN preparation of the
  recent PCs only; false in every build but a debug test one (-Pgnlink.testStandbyAutoPrepare=true, refused for a
  release). A lease that exists keeps its Pings either way.
- DirectoryClient: /api/hosts standby {supported, relay} (read-only), connect(standby = true) + standbyRelay, standbyAim.

Unit tests 304/0 (StandbyKeepTest 14 new). AVD behaviour: see the report (ke_avd).
